basic_identification.full_title: Semichrome Suede Upper Leather — Specification (First Revision)
basic_identification.sector_category: Chemical / Leather and Leather Products (finalised by the Leather, Tanning Materials and Allied Products Sectional Committee, CHD 17, under the Chemical Division Council of the Bureau of Indian Standards)

sectional_committee.name: Leather, Tanning Materials and Allied Products Sectional Committee

scope.summary: This standard prescribes requirements, chemical and physical testing methods, and sampling protocols for semichrome suede upper leather used in the manufacture of shoe uppers and allied leather goods.

certification_and_marking.standard_type: Product Specification (Chemical Department / Leather and Leather Products)
certification_and_marking.certification_status: Voluntary Product Specification. Manufacturers are highly encouraged to apply for a BIS license to print the prestigious BIS 'Standard Mark' (ISI Mark) on leather bundles as a certified guarantee of material, physical strength, and ECO conformity. Compliance with IS 14360 is heavily specified in footwear supply contracts, defense equipment tenders, and leather exports.

requirements.detail: The leather shall be vegetable tanned and subsequently rechromed (semichrome), featuring a good suede nap on the flesh side with the option of a snuffed grain side.
Thickness of the suede upper leather shall not vary by more than 0.1 mm on either side of the nominal thickness declared by the manufacturer, measured per LP:2 of IS 5914.
The semichrome suede leather must have a minimum tensile strength of 16 MPa, evaluated per LP:6 of IS 5914.
Elongation at break is capped at a maximum of 80 percent, evaluated per LP:6 of IS 5914 to prevent excessive shoe shape distortion under wear.
Sampling of the finished leather for quality-conformance tests must follow the exact methods outlined in IS 5868.
Final observed or calculated test values (strength, thickness, elongation) must be mathematically rounded off in accordance with IS 2:1960. The significant places must match the specified limits.

plain_language_summary.summary: IS 14360 : 2012 (First Revision) is the national Indian Standard specification establishing technical, physical, and testing requirements for semichrome suede upper leather. Maintained under the FAD/CHD 17 committee and reaffirmed in 2022, this standard regulates leather that is vegetable tanned and subsequently rechromed for shoe uppers. It mandates a strict thickness tolerance of ±0.1 mm, specifies a minimum tensile strength of 16 MPa, caps elongation at break at 80% to ensure durability, and outlines sampling procedures per IS 5868 and testing under IS 5914, verifying standard compliance and durability across India.
